newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Quake rocks north Philippines, no damage reported.
newsitem.headline: Quake rocks north Philippines, no damage reported.

text.p: A fairly strong earthquake jolted the northern Philippines early on Wednesday but there were no immediate reports of casualties or damage, the state volcanology institute said.
The tremor struck at about 2 a.m. (1800 GMT) on Tuesday and measured six on the open-ended Richter scale, based on preliminary data, an official at the institute said.
The quake was centred in a rural area about 45 kms (28 km) northwest of Laoag city, capital of Ilocos Norte province, he added.
A sergeant at the Laoag provincial police headquarters said the quake roused residents from their sleep but he had received no reports of casualties or damage.
